stages.name: Unauthenticated Web Exploitation
observables: HTTP POST requests to SharePoint Business Connectivity Services endpoints
Unauthenticated access to restricted SharePoint web paths
Inbound traffic to SharePoint web ports (80, 443)

stages.name: RCE via .NET Instantiation
observables: Custom .NET gadget chains in HTTP request bodies
Business Connectivity Services processing malicious .NET types

stages.name: SharePoint Shell Execution
observables: cmd.exe spawned by SharePoint service account
powershell.exe spawned by SharePoint service account

scenario.summary: An unauthenticated remote code execution chain against Microsoft SharePoint leverages an authentication bypass (CVE-2026-55040) to reach a secondary vulnerability in Business Connectivity Services (CVE-2026-63520). Attackers exploit an unsafe .NET type instantiation issue to execute arbitrary OS commands with the privileges of the SharePoint service account.

meta.rationale: Focus on internet-exposed SharePoint servers. Start with hosts identified by vulnerability findings for CVE-2026-55040 or CVE-2026-63520.
meta.hypothesis: An attacker is chaining an authentication bypass with a .NET gadget chain to execute shell commands on a SharePoint server via the Business Connectivity Services endpoint.

hunt.name: SharePoint Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
hunt.description: This hunt identifies exploitation of CVE-2026-63520 and CVE-2026-55040. It starts by scoping the estate for vulnerable SharePoint instances and then monitors for the critical indicator of SharePoint worker processes (w3wp.exe) or the Timer service spawning command-line interpreters. It uses a parallel workstream to baseline rare child processes and monitor for specific HTTP POST activity directed at the Business Connectivity Services (BCS) endpoints, which are the primary vector for this chain.

primitive_config.expected: Rows containing specific CVE IDs and associated device identifiers. Silence indicates no known vulnerable hosts are currently reporting this telemetry.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, time, user_name, parent_process_name, process_name, process_cmd_line FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{sharepoint_parents}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(parent_process_name) || ',') > 0) AND (instr(',' || '{{shell_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Detect a SharePoint worker or timer process launching a command-line interpreter, the direct outcome of RCE.
config.expected_signal: A SharePoint process spawning a shell is highly unusual and suggests successful RCE.

primitive_config.label: SharePoint Processes Spawning Shells
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, time, user_name, parent_process_name, process_name, process_cmd_line FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{sharepoint_parents}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(parent_process_name) || ',') > 0) AND (instr(',' || '{{shell_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: A SharePoint process spawning a shell is highly unusual and suggests successful RCE.

config.content: SELECT LOWER(process_name) AS proc, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{sharepoint_parents}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(parent_process_name) || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY LOWER(process_name) HAVING host_count <= 2 ORDER BY host_count ASC
config.description: Identify unusual binaries executed by SharePoint that are not standard shells, surfacing anomalies via prevalence.
config.expected_signal: A binary launched by SharePoint appearing on only one or two hosts. This captures custom payloads or renamed tools.

primitive_config.label: Baseline Rare SharePoint Child Processes
primitive_config.content: SELECT LOWER(process_name) AS proc, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{sharepoint_parents}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(parent_process_name) || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY LOWER(process_name) HAVING host_count <= 2 ORDER BY host_count ASC
primitive_config.expected: A binary launched by SharePoint appearing on only one or two hosts. This captures custom payloads or renamed tools.
